assets.theme: Classic Candy Cane Diagonal Stripe Seamless Background
assets.palette: candy red, cream white, evergreen accents
assets.prompt: Create a single commercially useful Christmas seamless background for mainstream retail packaging, greeting cards, e-commerce banners, and gift wrap concepts. The entire 16:9 image should present one repeatable pattern, not a collection board. Build a clean seamless diagonal stripe design inspired by classic candy cane colors, with alternating red and cream bands and small evenly spaced evergreen pinstripe accents to add richness without clutter. The pattern should tile convincingly and maintain consistent rhythm across the whole frame. Art style: crisp commercial flat surface-pattern design with smooth edges, subtle paper print texture, and balanced repeat spacing. Keep the mood classic, familiar, and highly saleable, like a dependable holiday gift-wrap background that works for many brands. Ensure there are multiple repeating visual elements across the pattern so it feels designed, not like a simple two-color stripe. No text, no logo, no watermark, no mockup packaging, and no copied marketplace listing layout.
assets.negative_prompt: text, logo, watermark, board preview, mockup package, one single object, poor repeat seam, blurry edges, neon palette, branding

research.reusability_rationale: A clean seamless candy-cane background is a staple that can be recolored and reused across many mainstream holiday campaigns.

assets.theme: Holly Berry Dot Seamless Gift Wrap Background
assets.palette: deep red, evergreen, cream, soft blush
assets.prompt: Generate a single seamless Christmas background designed for mainstream gift wrap, retail signage, party supplies, and festive stationery. The full 16:9 image should show one repeating surface pattern rather than multiple sample panels. Use a balanced all-over repeat of holly leaves, red berry clusters, and small dotted filler motifs on a warm cream ground. The repeat should be seamless and visually steady, with enough density to feel premium but not overcrowded. Art style: polished commercial flat illustration with clean vector-like edges, slight printed-paper texture, and tidy motif spacing suitable for mass-market seasonal products. Make the pattern feel traditional and broadly licensable, not whimsical in a niche way. Include multiple visible repeats so the tiled nature is evident across the whole frame. No text, no watermark, no brand identifiers, no circles or product badges, and no presentation-board layout.
assets.negative_prompt: title text, logo, badge, multiple swatches, watermark, sparse empty layout, photographic props, visible seams, copyrighted icons, over-detailed leaves

assets.theme: Red Green Tartan Snowflake Seamless Background
